summary: Notes Feature Testing - Complete. All backend (11/11) and frontend tests passed. The personal notes feature on the Journey page works correctly with a collapsible right sidebar. Features tested: create notes, pin/unpin notes (moves between Pinned/Recent sections), edit notes inline, delete notes. Badge count updates correctly when panel is closed.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/programs/{program_id}/notes returns {pinned: [], recent: []} structure
Backend: POST /api/programs/{program_id}/notes creates a note and returns it with note_id, content, is_pinned, timestamps
Backend: POST with empty content correctly returns 400
Backend: POST to non-existent program returns 404
Backend: PUT /api/notes/{note_id} with {is_pinned: true} pins the note
Backend: PUT /api/notes/{note_id} with {is_pinned: false} unpins the note
Backend: PUT /api/notes/{note_id} with {content: 'updated'} edits the note content
Backend: PUT to non-existent note returns 404
Backend: DELETE /api/notes/{note_id} deletes the note and returns {ok: true}
Backend: DELETE non-existent note returns 404
Backend: Pinned notes appear in 'pinned' section, unpinned in 'recent' section
Frontend: Notes tab visible on right edge of Journey page (data-testid='notes-tab')
Frontend: Notes tab shows note count badge (updates from 2 to 3 after save, back to 2 after delete)
Frontend: Clicking tab opens panel (data-testid='notes-panel') sliding from right
Frontend: Panel shows 'My Notes UCLA' header with close button
Frontend: Composer textarea with placeholder 'Jot down thoughts, impressions, pros/cons...'
Frontend: Character counter shows '0 / 500' and updates as you type
Frontend: Save Note button creates note and shows 'Note saved' toast
Frontend: Saved note appears immediately in the notes list under RECENT section
Frontend: Hover over note shows pin/edit/delete buttons
Frontend: Pin button moves note to PINNED section with 'PINNED' badge
Frontend: Unpin button moves note back to RECENT section
Frontend: Edit button shows inline textarea with Save/Cancel buttons
Frontend: Editing and saving shows 'Note updated' toast
Frontend: Delete button removes note and shows 'Note deleted' toast
Frontend: Closing panel shows collapsed tab with updated count badge
seed_data_creation: Test notes created and deleted during testing on prog_pro_test1 (UCLA). 2 original notes remain in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Notes feature fully tested. Key components: (1) NotesSidebar.js is the main component, integrated at bottom of RecruitingJourney.js, (2) Backend has 4 endpoints in routes/notes.py: list (GET), create (POST), update (PUT), delete (DELETE), (3) Notes are stored per-program with tenant isolation, (4) Frontend uses data-testid attributes for all interactive elements. Test program: prog_pro_test1 (UCLA) has 2 remaining notes after test cleanup.
